title: Anime Wow
blurb: Sparkly-eyed, breathless amazement at absolutely nothing. Anime characters deploy this gasp at sunsets, at sandwiches, and at the concept of friendship, and that reliability is exactly what makes it so useful when applied ironically. Somebody parallel parks adequately? Anime wow. A vending machine produces correct change on the first attempt? Anime wow. It supplies cheap awe in unlimited quantities and never runs out, which is more than can be said for sincere enthusiasm. Best deployed at the smallest achievement in the room, with a straight face.
origin: The classic wide-eyed anime gasp, memed as ironic amazement at nothing.
